# Rolling Stone

> Rolling Stone covers music, film, TV, politics, and culture with breaking news, artist interviews, reviews, and in-depth features on entertainment and current events.

Rolling Stone is a leading entertainment and news publication covering the music industry, celebrity news, television, film, and political commentary. The site features breaking news, investigative reporting, artist profiles, and cultural features alongside a secure tip submission system for journalists.

## Key Topics

- Music News
- Celebrity Litigation
- Artist Profiles
- Music Industry
- Concert Announcements
- Entertainment Coverage
- Celebrity Interviews
- Breaking News
- Cultural Features
- Jay-Z
- Anthropic
- BMG
- Survivor
- Reality TV
- Political Commentary

## Core Content Sections

- [Rolling Stone Homepage](https://www.rollingstone.com): Rolling Stone homepage with music, film, TV and political news
- [Music](https://www.rollingstone.com/music): Rolling Stone music news, reviews, artist features and concert coverage
- [TV & Movies](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies): TV and movie news, reviews, interviews and Oscars coverage
- [Politics](https://www.rollingstone.com/politics): Political news and commentary on Trump administration and policy
- [Culture](https://www.rollingstone.com/culture): Cultural features on crime, AI, conspiracy theories and celebrity

## Music News & Industry

- [BMG Sues Anthropic for Copyright Infringement in Training of Claude](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/bmg-anthropic-copyright-lawsuit-justin-bieber-bruno-mars-1235533474): BMG sues Anthropic for using artist lyrics to train Claude AI
- [Jay-Z to Perform 'Reasonable Doubt,' 'The Blueprint' at Yankee Stadium](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/jay-z-yankee-stadium-concert-reasonable-doubt-the-blueprint-1235533391): Jay-Z announces Yankee Stadium concerts celebrating album anniversaries
- [Labrinth Slams Music Industry in Scathing Social Media Post](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/labrinth-euphoria-music-industry-criticism-1235532763): Labrinth criticizes music industry and Columbia Records on social media
- [Afroman Wins 'Lemon Pound Cake' Lawsuit Over Raid-Turned-Music Video](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/afroman-trial-lemon-pound-cake-video-1235533623): Afroman wins lawsuit against officers over police raid music video
- [Best New Music: Kacey Musgraves, James Blake, Kim Gordon](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-features/kacey-musgraves-james-blake-kim-gordon-songs-you-need-to-know-1235530013): Weekly roundup of best new music from Kacey Musgraves and others

## Artist Profiles & Features

- [How Geese Became the Buzziest Band in Years](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-features/geese-podcast-why-real-bands-matter-1235527035): Profile of rising indie rock band Geese and Cameron Winter's solo success
- [Zac Brown on 'Survivor': Country Star Fishes, Dives, Cooks for Cast](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-features/survivor-anniversary-zac-brown-superfan-1235532685): Zac Brown appears on Survivor Season 50 in Fiji as superfan
- [The Story of Harvey Prager, the Last Great Weed Smuggler](https://www.rollingstone.com/culture/culture-features/harvey-prager-weed-smuggler-1235518138): Feature on Harvey Prager, legendary marijuana smuggler from 1970s Florida

## Celebrity News & Entertainment

- [Kanye West Challenges $140,000 Jury Award at Malibu-Mansion Trial](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/kanye-west-challenge-jury-award-malibu-mansion-trial-1235532691): Kanye West challenges $140K damages verdict in Malibu mansion case
- [Neil Sedaka's Cause of Death Revealed](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/neil-sedaka-cause-of-death-1235533608): Neil Sedaka's cause of death determined following musician's passing
- [Lisa Kudrow Says She Is Finally Watching 'Friends'](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/lisa-kudrow-watching-friends-kimmel-interview-1235533631): Lisa Kudrow discusses watching Friends on Jimmy Kimmel Live

## Journalist Resources

- [Have a Tip for Rolling Stone?](https://www.rollingstone.com/tips): Submit tips securely to Rolling Stone journalists via email or Tor
